rationale: Evidence: iteration 6 (sensor_size 0.016) scored 82.98, below iteration 5's 84.33. Oval steering_oscillation rose to 0.256, above the 0.25 return threshold, and max_error stayed at 0.0619 to 0.0654 m. The wider footprint did not move the off-track floor and made the oscillation worse. Both revert conditions in the Evaluator's plan are met, so I am reverting the footprint to 0.012. Geometry stays at the iteration 5 sensor layout (y 0.06, x -0.04 to 0.04, weights -2 to 2) because that layout is the best raced design. Change: sensor_size 0.016 to 0.012, and kd 0.25 to 0.30 with kp 4.0, following the plan for this case. Base_speed 1.3, ki 0.3 and last_direction are unchanged, so the race isolates the damping change against iteration 5. Expected result: score at or above 84.33 and oval steering_oscillation below about 0.25. Risk: iterations 3 and 4 suggest kd may raise oscillation alongside kp (iteration 3 at kd 0.2 gave 0.208 and iteration 4 at kd 0.25 gave 0.254 on the oval, though y also changed between iterations 4 and 5), so oscillation could rise rather than fall. If the score falls below 84.33 or oscillation exceeds 0.25 on the oval, fall back to kd 0.25 (iteration 5). max_error is still expected to sit near 0.062 to 0.065 m, so the off-track floor remains the main open problem. Next lever if it persists: a narrower or wider sensor x spread (for example x -0.03 to 0.03) rather than further gain tuning. Do not raise base_speed until progress nears 0.995 with no line loss. Completion within 3 s is not expected at base_speed 1.3.
